coverage_notes.result_summary: Official CMS listing had no new notices; 12 targeted searches found no verified nonduplicate new US or territory healthcare-access loss or effective essential-service restoration during the hourly window. Proposed Greenbrier Valley labor/delivery reopening was expressly excluded because actual resumption was not confirmed.

Sunday reporting and search indexing can delay discovery.
